name: How do custom home builders differ from production home builders?

mainEntity.name: How do custom home builders differ from production home builders?

acceptedAnswer.text: Custom home builders construct unique, one-of-a-kind homes designed specifically for an individual client, offering extensive personalization in every detail from layout to finishes. They typically build on your chosen lot. Production home builders, in contrast, construct multiple homes based on a limited selection of pre-designed floor plans in planned communities, offering fewer customization options. The custom approach provides greater flexibility and bespoke results, while production homes often offer quicker build times and potentially lower costs due to economies of scale.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom builders create unique, personalized homes on client-owned lots, while production builders offer limited design options in planned communities.
